class.name: OcgPrs3dTextaspect
class.brief_description: Defines the attributes when displaying a text.
class.description: ! Defines the attributes when displaying a text.

method.name: default
method.description: Constructs an empty framework for defining display attributes of text.

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Sets the color of the type used in text display.

method.name: SetFont
method.description: Sets the font used in text display.

method.name: SetHeight
method.description: Sets the height of the text.

method.name: Height
method.description: Returns the height of the text box.

method.name: SetVerticalJustification
method.description: Sets the vertical alignment of text.

method.name: HorizontalJustification
method.description: Returns the horizontal alignment of the text. The range of values includes: - left - center - right, and - normal (justified).

method.name: VerticalJustification
method.description: Returns the vertical alignment of the text. The range of values includes: - normal - top - cap - half - base - bottom

method.name: Orientation
method.description: Returns the orientation of the text. Text can be displayed in the following directions: - up - down - left, or - right

method.name: Aspect
method.description: Returns the purely textual attributes used in the display of text. These include: - color - font - height/width ratio, that is, the expansion factor, and - space between characters.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
